articles.title: Tiny iron particles may hold clues to the Moon’s magnetic past
articles.summary: Scientists found an unusual form of iron in glass from Chang’e-6 lunar soil. Its stable magnetic behavior suggests it might preserve clues about the Moon’s past.

articles.title: Kelvin waves can raise water levels along the US West Coast
articles.summary: An AP report forecasts Kelvin waves that could lift US West Coast sea levels by six inches to a foot. Higher water can increase flooding and beach erosion when combined with tides and storms.

articles.title: Looped boat propellers could help quiet the ocean for whales
articles.summary: A company is testing looped propellers designed to reduce underwater noise. It reports quieter results and is working with Ocean Alliance, but benefits for whales are still being investigated.
